🧵2/5: Musk’s Vision 💡

• U.S. government spending is plagued by inefficiencies & fraud.
• Blockchain (the tech behind Bitcoin & Dogecoin) could secure transactions, streamline payments, & track federal spending in real time.

🧵3/5: The Doge Department 

• With support from David Sacks & Trump’s team, a national crypto reserve is being discussed.
• Potential options? Dogecoin or a new blockchain to manage federal transactions.
